prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: mut-bigN-27
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 5bb8cdb7838e15c8
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Loopback send 0xa5 never set recv_buf_valid, causing `TRAP: uart timeout, no byte received` and `FAIL 0xdead` instead of a received byte. Expected recv_divcnt to increment each cycle to exceed cfg_divider and advance recv_state 1->2 and 10->0, but line 74 does `recv_divcnt <= recv_divcnt + 0` so the counter stays 0 and reception never completes. Root cause is the zero increment in picosoc/simpleuart.v line 74 stalling the UART receiver divider.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 5bb8cdb7838e15c8 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
